name: ai-meter
description: Claude usage in the status bar — subscription limits (5-hour session, weekly), or session tokens and estimated cost for Bedrock/API setups.

aiMeter.mode.description: What to show. 'subscription': Claude subscription limits from the OAuth usage API. 'cost': session tokens and estimated cost, computed locally from Claude Code transcripts (for Bedrock/API-key setups with no subscription limits). 'auto': cost when Claude Code is configured for Bedrock (CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK), subscription otherwise.

aiMeter.pollMinutes.description: How often to poll the usage API, in minutes.

aiMeter.display.description: Show percent remaining (fuel-tank style) or percent used.

aiMeter.showModelWeekly.description: Also show the model-scoped weekly limit (e.g. Opus/Sonnet) when the API reports one.

aiMeter.warnBelow.description: Highlight the status bar item (warning color) when any limit has less than this percent remaining.

aiMeter.errorBelow.description: Highlight the status bar item (error color) when any limit has less than this percent remaining.

aiMeter.hideWhenUnavailable.description: Hide the status bar item entirely when no Claude credentials are found (instead of showing a dash).
